title: populus ilicifolia
intro: Populus ilicifolia, commonly known as Holly-leaved Poplar, is a deciduous tree native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Populus ilicifolia include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antibacterial properties, making it a natural remedy for wounds and infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
